topic: Managing Fee Installments and Manual Amount Entry
summary: Explains how to handle fee installments, including default selection, selecting all installments, and manually entering a custom payment amount, along with the fee head sequence.
steps: In the fee collection section, review the due demand and available installments.
The system automatically selects the first or current due installment based on the date.
To select all installments, click 'Select All'.
To enter a custom payment amount, directly input the desired amount (e.g., 10,000) in the designated field. The system will allocate this amount based on the predefined fee head sequence.
Alternatively, manually adjust amounts for individual fee heads if specific allocations are required.
business_rules: Installments are automatically selected based on their due dates.
Manual amount entry allocates funds according to a predefined fee head sequence.
The fee head sequence can be customized.
important_notes: This sequence can be adjusted as per institutional policy.
